custody_hash.stage_a_placeholder_was: deterministic native FNV-1a walk over sealed keys, explicitly provenance-only
custody_hash.stage_b_implements: the accepted P07 canonical semantic custody hash: semantic_hash over {contract: I07_CONTRACT_ID, relations: [{ref, semantic_content_hash, replay_identity}] sorted by ref.key, authority_snapshots: [{authority_ref, snapshot_semantic_content_hash}] sorted by authority_ref.key}
custody_hash.validated_on_every_decision: validate_decision_replay requires exact equality against the LIVE native owner custody hash, so a decision carrying a foreign or stale custody identity is refused

semantic_hash_and_projection.sealed_at_admission: the trusted semantic_hash of each relation's and each snapshot's semantic_projection()
semantic_hash_and_projection.reverified_at_resolve: the projection is re-hashed on EVERY resolve_exact and compared to the sealed content_hash; a mismatch raises 'owner custody relation semantic hash mismatch'
semantic_hash_and_projection.snapshot_reverification: authority snapshots re-hash their projection on every positive validation and refuse 'custodied authority snapshot semantic identity drift'
semantic_hash_and_projection.replay_identity_verification: replay_identity is re-read and compared to the sealed value on every resolve

replay_identity.canonical_preimage_ported: contract + request(_relation_key_material) + state + relation_ref + authority_ref + authority_operation + owner_custody_hash + authority_snapshot_content_hash
replay_identity.byte_exact_with_python: the request sub-mapping is byte-identical because canonical_json sorts keys

defects_found_and_fixed.title: trusted canonicalize can return its INPUT object unchanged, and the result was treated as an owned reference
defects_found_and_fixed.detail: canonicalize({}) is {} and canonicalize('e') is 'e'. trusted_canon returned that value and every caller DECREFed it at cleanup, stealing a reference from a live caller object. Symptom: EXC_BAD_ACCESS inside object_recursive_isinstance on a later call.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: trusted_canon now Py_INCREFs the result unconditionally, so ownership is real regardless of whether canonicalize allocated.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: caller-supplied directionality_or_symmetric arrived BORROWED and was DECREFed at cleanup
defects_found_and_fixed.detail: PyArg_ParseTupleAndKeywords yields borrowed references for supplied arguments. The cleanup path unconditionally DECREFs directionality, freeing the caller's object. Symptom: EXC_BAD_ACCESS inside _PyObject_Malloc on a later call.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: an explicit Py_INCREF is taken when the caller supplies directionality.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: double free of the source-ref fast sequence on nested error paths
defects_found_and_fixed.detail: PySequence_Fast result was DECREFed after the copy loop and then DECREFed again on error paths inside the following block.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: replaced with Py_CLEAR at the single release point.
defects_found_and_fixed.found_by: differential parity harness (bus error during repeated decide calls)

verified_absent_in_normal_build.STAGE_A_FAULT_INJECT: present in the Stage A source but only under #ifdef; the Stage A normal recipe never defines it
verified_absent_in_normal_build.STAGE_B_FAULT_INJECT_RESOLVE: strings on the shipped binary returns 0 matches for this symbol family, confirming the diagnostic is compiled out

fail_capability.method: rebuild with -DSTAGE_B_FAULT_INJECT_RESOLVE, which returns from resolve_exact before the semantic_projection() re-hash
fail_capability.interpretation: the court depends on the re-hash control rather than passing vacuously

stress_evidence.result: no crash, no abort, no corruption; owner remained self-consistent (custody hash stable) after the whole sweep

other_path_hygiene: exact-type admission on relations and snapshots (Py_TYPE equality)
exact list/tuple admission so no hostile __iter__/__len__/__getattribute__ drives admission
two-phase admission: nothing is sealed unless every member validates
two-phase source-ref ordering: sorted by exact ref key, never by comparing dicts
all C allocations freed in StageBOwner_dealloc via stb_free_contents
ref/key/hash re-verification on every resolve, never trust of a sealed object
